title: The Command Palette dock is disappearing
author: comassdesign

status.label: Likely covered by the dock topology fix
status.detail: Current Command Palette dock code already contains a monitor-topology recovery change that explicitly targets docking, undocking, and similar transient display reconfiguration cases that leave the dock empty or missing.

next_action.label: Point to the monitor-topology fix and request a retest
next_action.reason: A recent upstream fix directly targets the same lid-close, monitor-disconnect, and missing-dock family.

judgment.rationale: The issue matches the monitor-topology churn class already addressed by upstream PR #49814, which explicitly describes docking, undocking, Win+P changes, and stale monitor snapshots leaving the Command Palette Dock empty or missing.
evidence: The issue says the Command Palette dock disappears after lid-close hibernation or after a monitor deep-sleep disconnect and wake cycle.
A confirmer says the dock crash started after an update and that restarting PowerToys temporarily restores it.
Current DockWindowManager and DockWindow code now debounce monitor-change events, refresh monitor caches, and recreate AppBar registration on topology changes.
File history shows these dock-monitor fixes landed in upstream PR #49814 after this issue was filed.
judgment.recommended_action: Treat the item as handled by the monitor-topology fix and ask for a retest on a build that includes #49814.

fix_assessment.rationale: Current main already contains a dock monitor-topology recovery fix that matches the reported wake and reconnect scenarios.

issue_context.summary: The Command Palette dock disappears after hibernation, lid-close, or display deep-sleep reconnect. Current main already carries a dock monitor-topology recovery fix for this class of display-change failures.
known_information: The reporter is on PowerToys 0.100.2 from the Microsoft Store.
The issue reports two symptoms: the dock disappears after sleep or display reconnect, and icons can be missing on startup.
A confirmer says their monitor disconnects during deep sleep, the dock crashes after reconnect, and restarting PowerToys restores it temporarily.
There are no attachments, assignees, or linked work on the live issue.
inferences: The public repro lines up with transient display-topology churn rather than ordinary dock visibility settings.
The missing icons at startup may be the same stale-monitor snapshot family, because the current dock fix also updates monitor caches even when no dock window is visible.
issue_context.analysis: The current source tree already contains a recent dock-monitor recovery change with the same wake, reconnect, and topology-change shape described here. The maintainer action is to connect this report to that fix and seek retest feedback, not to start a new design.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue body, the confirming comment, labels, assignees, and empty live timeline.
Inspected DockWindowManager.cs and DockWindow.xaml.cs, which now debounce monitor changes, refresh target monitors, and recreate AppBar registration on topology changes.
Reviewed file history and the upstream summary for PR #49814, which explicitly targets missing or broken dock state after docking, undocking, or display-mode changes.

actions.label: Point to dock topology fix #49814

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed lid-close and deep-sleep reproduction. Current main already contains the Command Palette dock monitor-topology fix from #49814, which specifically targets dock/undock, display-mode, and stale-monitor snapshots that can leave the dock empty, missing, or misconfigured after display changes. Please retest on a build that includes #49814 and confirm whether the dock still disappears after sleep or display reconnect.
